question: Curd and Vinegar taste sour because they contain _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**acids**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Acid is a substance which has the property to **convert blue litmus to red**.

 
 
• It gives **hydrogen ions **in the solution which makes it taste sour.
 
• It reacts with the** base to give salt**.
 
• On reacting with metal they produce **hydrogen gas**.
 
 
 
• Curd and Vinegar contain **lactic acid** and **acetic acid**.
 
• Due to the presence of** *Lactobacillus *bacteria in milk**, it converts it to curd.
 
• The presence of ***Acetobacter *in alcohol** ferment it to form Vinegar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__**Difference Between Acid and Base**__

 
 

 **Acid**
 **Base**
 
 

 The substance has the property to form hydrogen ions (H+ ions) in the solution.
 The substance property accepts protons or releases hydroxide (OH-) ions in aqueous solutions.
 
 

 It has a pH balance of less than 7
 It has a pH balance of more than 7
 
 

 Most of acids are sours
 It has a bitter taste
 
 

 Salts and water are produced after a reaction with acids
 Bases change the solution colour to pink when dissolved
